name: 双语错位字幕·配音成片

renderProfile.source: original BT.2020 HLG/PQ, no SDR proxy

durationPolicy: actual narration duration plus approximately 0.6 second tail; never random 8-15 seconds
voicePolicy: user supplied narration; transcribe and review per-character timestamps anew for each audio

motion.chinese: 0.20s character rise 48/58/68px, alternating -5/+6deg rotation; word-aligned starts
motion.title: 0.30s slide/rise entrance, 0.18s exit unless held to final frame

distribution: Template HTML source, preparation helper, GSAP runtime and shared OFL fonts only; excludes narration, library video, reference video, screenshots and completed examples.

gpuHdrTest.visualQa: Tone-mapped inspection of titles, bilingual captions, transitions and final frame; HDR display appearance not certified

validation.fontMatch: Portable approximate match to reference, confirmed in rendered examples
